name: cytozoe
description: CytoZoe — local-first astronaut health evidence and review workspace. Convenience scripts; the app lives in backend/ (FastAPI) and frontend/ (React + Vite).

scripts.data: node scripts/run-python.mjs scripts/fetch_data.py --all && node scripts/run-python.mjs scripts/verify_data.py --strict && node scripts/run-python.mjs scripts/import_data.py --all
scripts.test: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m pytest backend -q && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend test
